南洋廳統計年鑑 1933

Nan'yōchō tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the South Seas Government), 第三回 (No. 3), figures mainly for 昭和4–8 (1929–1933), published 昭和10年10月 (October 1935)
南洋廳, パラオ (昭和十年)

All 237 numbered tables are transcribed, with the appendix table of weights and measures (度量衡比較表); the contents, the maps, the statistical charts (統計圖表), the prose survey (概說) and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted; a few cells whose totals did not add up were re-read by a reader who had not seen the first reading. Figures are kept exactly as printed, including points or spaces printed where a comma is expected. Small figures printed above a cell (foreigners, half-year taxpayers, quantities) are given in the same cell after the figure; in the trade tables 210–213 a number of these small quantities could not be read and are marked [?]. About 65 of some 84,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
